g.text: Paritok Overall Impact: Development and Token Efficiency
Paritok compression pipeline (account-wide, all API keys)
14-query real-corpus batch: 54% average reduction, up to 95% peak
End-to-end gold-set runs: 26.38% to 60.26% reduction across 3 dated runs
340.82M tokens saved of 385.86M processed, 88.3% of volume, 107.25 USD estimated cost saved across 5.6K requests
